summary: Implemented S02T08 handoff and workflow-next directive compilation. Added compileHandoffAgentDirectiveBundle and handoffDirectiveDataByRegistryId, expanded handoff/workflow-next directive data to include summary IDs and URIs, branch/root, subject status, evidence and verification IDs, unresolved blockers, open descendants, gates, reservations, and next command/workflow inputs. Reused the richer workflow-next data from closeout/git/recovery paths. Updated golden fixtures and compiler tests for session handoff and workflow navigation.
